principles: Make G03 an independent executable baseline group, not a documentation-only claim.
Preserve no-false-DONE boundaries: completion prose without machine evidence must not close any required row.
Keep this slice narrow: add one smoke and update only the baseline document.
Separate local synthetic evidence from rollout, Authority, production, or multi-host claims.
drivers: User wants all remaining 10x15 baseline groups completed group by group.
G03 must prove prose-only closure is insufficient even when all 15 rows are present.
Existing evaluator behavior should be validated, not broadened, for this slice.

options.name: A: standalone G03 prose-only smoke plus doc boundary update
pros: Keeps the implementation reviewable and comparable with G01/G02.
Matches the documented G03 scenario exactly.
cons: Adds one more task-level smoke to maintain.

options.name: B: skip G03 and jump to a full combined 10x15 smoke
pros: Could complete the full suite sooner in one large change.
cons: Too broad and easier to false-DONE.
Would make it harder to audit which negative-control group failed.

options.name: C: document G03 as implemented without executable smoke
cons: It would be the exact prose-only anti-pattern G03 is meant to block.
Does not provide machine evidence for the baseline.

chosen: A: standalone G03 prose-only smoke plus doc boundary update
rationale: Choose the standalone G03 smoke because it proves the exact prose-only failure mode with fresh machine evidence while preserving the group-by-group audit boundary.

preMortem.scenario: G03 is marked implemented based only on documentation updates.
preMortem.trigger: The team accepts prose that says prose-only closure is blocked without a runnable smoke.
preMortem.consequence: The baseline itself becomes a prose-only false-DONE example.
preMortem.mitigation: Create and run a standalone G03 smoke that asserts every row lacks closureEvidence and remains open.

preMortem.scenario: The smoke accidentally closes rows because prose wording is treated as evidence.
preMortem.trigger: Rows include completion text and the test forgets to assert missing_closure_evidence.
preMortem.consequence: The evaluator could allow a full completion claim for prose-only rows.
preMortem.mitigation: Assert zero closed rows, 15 open rows, evidenceState missing, and missing_closure_evidence for every row.

preMortem.scenario: The document claims the full 10x15 baseline is complete after G03.
preMortem.trigger: Progress wording broadens from G01-G03 implemented to all groups implemented.
preMortem.consequence: Users would think the full baseline is done while G04-G10 remain absent.
preMortem.mitigation: Keep G04-G10 future in the table and Non-Goals, and run doc grep plus delivery review.
